summary_1line: After Arjuna’s devastating victories, night falls; next morning Bhishma leads the Kaurava army into a massive clash where he and others charge Arjuna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna’s chariot with white horses and the ape-banner advances as Bhishma’s vast army, filled with elephants and waving standards, surges forward like storm clouds.
The battlefield sky turns into a dusty canopy as thousands of conches, drums, and twanging bows sound while armies collide.
Bhishma with a palmyra-bannered standard charges directly toward the lightning-like chariot of Arjuna amid crashing elephants and falling warriors.
